name: smartreach-ai
description: SmartReach AI — AI marketing automation platform. Connect your business once. AI creates, schedules, and publishes your marketing automatically.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,worker,web -c blue,magenta,green "npm run dev -w @smartreach/api" "npm run dev -w @smartreach/worker" "npm run dev -w @smartreach/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @smartreach/common && npm run build -w @smartreach/ai && npm run build -w @smartreach/social && npm run build -w @smartreach/scheduler && npm run build -w @smartreach/analytics && npm run build -w @smartreach/publish && npm run build -w @smartreach/api && npm run build -w @smartreach/worker && npm run build -w @smartreach/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @smartreach/common && npm run typecheck -w @smartreach/ai && npm run typecheck -w @smartreach/api && npm run typecheck -w @smartreach/worker && npm run typecheck -w @smartreach/web
